g.text: Full-feature audit: C5-2 marker identity versus condition-specific detection
Labels: detected cells / all C5-2 cells. Thymus Ctrl has only 11 cells.
Il17a: 0 / 15,532 retained cells; Il17f: 2 / 15,532 (both Ctrl spleen, outside C5-2).
Detection is not cytokine secretion; these percentages have no independent-animal inference.
